public_rationale: The deadline is 2028-05-22, after the evaluation date. The reviewed benchmark result is substantial, but its evaluator explicitly says it does not establish AGI. No decisive event found meets the early-resolution rule. The ten-year qualification does not assert that AGI will arrive within ten years.
limitations: Different definitions of AGI could yield different judgments.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AGI is highly unlikely to arrive within three years, though it cannot be ruled out within ten.

statement.excerpt: And even though I highly doubt AGI will arrive in three years, I can’t absolutely promise you it won’t happen in 10.
statement.document_title: The “AI 2027” Scenario: How realistic is it?

from_speaker: AGI will arrive in three years
our_interpretation: Three years means the interval ending on 2028-05-22.
AGI means a system with broadly human-level general learning and intellectual capabilities, rather than success on one benchmark.
The forecast is assessed directionally. One outcome cannot establish whether an unstated probability was well calibrated.
The ten-year statement acknowledges uncertainty through 2035-05-22; it is neither a prediction of arrival nor an antecedent condition.
criteria.support_condition: At the three-year deadline, no system has been independently established to meet the stated broad AGI reading. This would support only the directional forecast.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system is independently established to meet the broad AGI reading on or before 2028-05-22. This would contradict the directional forecast, without proving that a low-probability judgment was irrational.
